etymology.historical_story: Sachin is attested as a personal name, notably in the name of Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar. That attestation establishes a name bearer, not a Malay lexical meaning or the identity intended by this packet. Without an original sentence or a reliable name-etymology source, its deeper origin should remain unspecified rather than receive an invented Sanskrit explanation.
